notes.title: Indie Royale Debut Bundle 17 Steam Keys!
notes.notes:
Hello, Due to a lack of communication from IndieRoyale, I'll be taking the initiative in giving out keys by hand to all purchasers of the bundle! Please forward your original receipt from IndieRoyale to the email address below from the Email you wish to receive the Key on! I apologize that this will take time for keys to be distributed as I'll be doing it by hand, but please be patient waiting for your key.

 Thank you very much for supporting me through the IndieRoyale campaign, and if you're just reading this, thank you for taking the time to view Puzzle Sages!

Please Send your Indie Royale Key Submissions to 
puzzlesagesroyale@gmail.com
